name: IPS Packaging & Automation
old_description: From materials to automation, IPS delivers reliable packaging solutions backed by nationwide distribution and experts who understand your operation.
about:
Founded in 1976 in Orangeburg, South Carolina, IPS Packaging & Automation operates as a certified service-disabled veteran-owned business with a nationwide distribution network. The company began as a packaging supplies provider and has expanded over five decades to offer equipment, automation, and engineering services across the United States.

The company supplies industrial packaging materials such as boxes, bubble wrap, tape, and void fill, while also providing packaging equipment, end-of-line automation systems, conveyor integration, robotic palletizing, and custom engineering and kitting services. Its nationwide network enables responsive delivery and technical support for packaging line optimization.

IPS serves a broad range of industries including aerospace, automotive, food production, medical, electronics, e-commerce fulfillment, and transportation logistics, among others. The firm also offers sustainable packaging options such as kraft paper and recyclable void fill alternatives to help customers reduce material waste.

IPS emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certification, veteran ownership, and a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing as key differentiators. The company states its mission is to deliver packaging expertise proudly based in the USA, focusing on exceeding customer expectations through continuous learning and operational integrity.
